meta.source: Tan Skillhub Design System project/tokens.json (version 1791818330-1ed6); same values as landing-page/src/marketplace/tokens.css
meta.generator: desktop/scripts/generate-design-tokens.mjs writes desktop/src/styles/design-tokens.css; run `npm run tokens` after editing this file
deviations: muted.light is #66728a instead of the design system #68748a so muted text on bg reaches 4.5:1 (the design system value is 4.4:1 on bg)
color tokens with "scope": "desktop" are APP supplements (window border, overlays, translucent chrome, scrollbar) that the design system does not define

the pre-#258 legacy aliases (--accent, --ink2, --line2, --tsh-* …) were removed in V6 (#263); the few legacy values without a design-system equivalent live on as desktop supplements (line-strong, brand-line, warning-line, danger-tint, danger-line, shadow-sheet)
motion tokens are APP supplements: the design system names 200ms hover lift and a standard ease; the desktop also times sheets and toasts with them

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every section; the window shell.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list containers, header, dropdowns.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Active sort tab, inline search field, skeleton blocks, hover row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and row dividers. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken (>=12:1 both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, metrics, captions. >=4.5:1 on bg and surface in both themes (desktop deviation, see meta).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active nav, links, verified mark, focus ring.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Active nav pill, selected filter, brand Tag fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Trending deltas, live dot, installed. Always paired with an arrow or word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: API-key needed text and key icon.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the API-key Tag.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Load errors and failed states only; always with a word.

tokens.name: logo-night
tokens.usage: The logo's charcoal ground. Night TopicCard fill and night avatar tile.

tokens.name: logo-mint
tokens.usage: Logo iridescence, mint stop. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: logo-lilac
tokens.usage: Logo iridescence, lilac stop. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: logo-blush
tokens.usage: Logo iridescence, blush stop. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Text on logo-mint, logo-lilac and logo-blush in both themes.

tokens.name: window-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around the rounded transparent window (.app-shell).

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal dialog backdrop (.modal-layer); same as the web --overlay.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Lighter backdrop behind side sheets (.scrim).

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Translucent sidebar over the window background (surface at 72%).

tokens.name: chrome-header
tokens.usage: Translucent sticky page head (bg at 82%).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Blurred popover menus (surface at 96%).

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on icon buttons, nav rows and segment tracks.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb.

tokens.name: scrollbar-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb on hover.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: hover borders, dashed drop zones and empty states.

tokens.name: brand-line
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured hairline around brand-tint fills.

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Hairline around warning-tint fills.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text (load errors, failed states).

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Hairline around danger-tint fills.
